_comment: Argo delivery schedules as DATA (not workflow code). The hourly schedule-runner workflow calls src/argo_scheduled.py, which fires any entry whose window matches the current UTC hour. Add a delivery by adding an entry here (Argo can propose this via a Contents-only PR) -- no workflow edit needed. days: list of 0-6 (Mon=0) or 'daily'. hour: 0-23 UTC. command: 'project' | 'watch'.
